Module be.kdg.programming.integrationproject
Package be.kdg.programming.integrationproject.view.game

Class GameView

java.lang.Object
be.kdg.programming.integrationproject.view.game.GameView
public class GameView extends Object
Main gameplay interface view wrapper. Arranges structural sub-views (Quiltboards, Timeboard) using a BorderPane layout, controls gameplay interaction buttons, and provides timed notification overlays.

1.0

      public GameView(String nameP1, String colorP1, String nameP2, String colorP2)

    • updatePatchSlot

      public void updatePatchSlot(int slotIndex, boolean[][] shape, int patchId, int buttonCost, int timeCost, int buttonIncome)
      Rebuilds the visual tile representation container within a target market slot. Extracts multi-dimensional layout arrays to render cell buttons and attach metadata.
      Parameters:
      slotIndex - market location sequence coordinate index targeting update operations
      shape - two-dimensional structural boolean grid layout tracking tile contours
      patchId - associated primary key tracking identifier identity code
      buttonCost - purchase currency metric threshold requirement representation value
      timeCost - linear progression path time cost metrics parameter value scale factor
      buttonIncome - recurring asset income points additions metric factor
